entries.candidate: CDC Beard second data centre, Beard Section 11 Block 25, Canberra (ACT DA202645149: three-storey data centre with 12 data halls, generators and future substation; approval conditional 29 September 2026)
entries.reason: The ACT DA Finder list view (ACTGOV_DAFINDER_LIST_VIEW on services1.arcgis.com, captured 27 October 2026 as local_data/country-research-refresh-operations-p4/act-dafinder-list-datacentre.json) records DA202645149 at Beard Section 11 Block 25 (Tantalum Street, Copper Crescent, Nickel Street). It was lodged on 20 August 2026 and decided 'Approval Conditional' on 29 September 2026, for 'Construction of a three storey data centre facility comprising of 12 data halls, energy generators, future substation, earthworks, utilities, driveway works, landscaping and associated works'. The DA centroid (-35.34038, 149.20917) is about 20 m from the existing CDC Beard BE1 locator, the retired Block 24 Section 11 polygon. CDC's 16 September deck maps BE2 at Beard as future development. The building is very probably BE2, a new project on the existing CDC Beard site, but three problems remain. (1) No captured record names CDC; the applicant shown is a planning consultant. (2) The DA documents are served from www.planning.act.gov.au, which answered HTTP 403 to robots.txt and was not used. (3) The ACT review period for a 29 September decision had not ended by 27 October, so the approval may not yet be in effect, and at most announced is supported. Even with identity proven, the addition is not expressible. The Beard site has one project, BE1, whose locator is a Polygon project_locator rather than a campus_locator, so _inherited_campus_locator refuses reuse. An explicit Point locator cannot equal the site's Polygon geometry.
entries.reopen_condition: A reviewed site geometry change that gives the Beard site a campus_locator (or a builder change allowing project_locator reuse), plus an official record naming CDC for Block 25 Section 11 Beard. Then admit BE2 as announced, or as permitted once the approval is shown to be in effect, within 85 days of 29 September 2026 (until 2026-12-23).
